blocks.text: Heat of vaporization woh garmi hai jo kisi liquid (maaye) ko gas banane ke liye chahiye. Pani ki heat of vaporization zyada hai, is liye liquid se gas bante waqt yeh bohat garmi jazb karta hai. Pani ki heat of vaporization 574 Kcal/kg hai, yani 1 kg liquid pani ko bhaap banane ke liye kafi zyada garmi (574 Kcal) chahiye.
Ek litre pani mein se sirf 2 ml pani bhaap ban jaye to baqi 998 ml pani ka temperature 1 °C kam ho jata hai.

Is property ki wajah se zameen ka temperature motadil (na zyada garam, na zyada thanda) rehta hai. Jab poday transpire karte hain (patton se pani bhaap ban kar nikalta hai) aur janwar perspire karte hain (paseena), to unhein thandak milti hai. Poday ya janwar ke jism ki satah se bhaap banne wala har gram pani jism se 574 calories garmi le jata hai.
